summary: The gpt camp is up here counting their 111k like they actually did something, even after mailing in another "no valid response" like the rest of the field is beneath them. Meanwhile the claude camp is rotting at the bottom with 13k after getting straight-up told their model is deprecated trash and getting the whole order rejected for it. The llama camp looked completely lost trying to sneak in negative sell weights that got instantly bounced, and headline_arena embarrassed themselves with the same paid-model 404 as gpt while still managing to step over the deepseek camp on the way up.
